relationships.subject: LZTR1
relationships.evidence_quote: Previous reports have comprehensively delineated the role of LZTR1 in inhibiting the RAS/MAPK pathway activation by promoting the ubiquitination and degradation of RAS [5].

relationships.subject: painful SWNTS-SWNs
relationships.evidence_quote: Notably, painful SWNTS-SWNs displayed significant upregulation of the RAS/MAPK pathway (Online Resource Fig. 5a), and activation of this pathway is thought linked with pain.

key_findings: Schwannomatosis schwannomas form four DNA methylation subgroups tied to tumor location and distinct transcriptional programs (cAMP, KRAS, MEK/PIGF, PIGF/VEGF).
Painful tumors show upregulated RAS/MAPK, PIGF/VEGF, ERBB2, mTOR and MEK pathways and more mast cells.
